forms.title: EU Entry/Exit System (EES) registration
forms.stoppedAt: There is no form to walk: EES registration is done at the border, at the first Schengen external crossing, in Italy or another Schengen state (the Vatican has no border control of its own). The only advance channel, the Travel to Europe mobile app, is supported only when entering Sweden and Portugal, and it is an app, not a web form.
